answer_records.encoding: opengrad.data.canonical.stable_json per CanonicalEvaluationExample row + LF, sorted by example_id

answer_strata.rule: every ANSWER figure is reported per stratum; a pooled figure only beside them (41 §9)

balance.method: prompt length in characters of the user message (quartiles, statistics.quantiles inclusive) and offered tools, per stratum and per other mode (41 §11)
balance.note: a difference is a stated limitation of any ANSWER-mode comparison, never corrected by reweighting after scores exist (41 §11)

confirmatory_when2call.gold_status: upstream When2Call gold, reused unchanged from Study 001

disjointness_tracked.p_unans_and_p_sealed: not built; whichever is built later must exclude P-CONF
disjointness_tracked.training_corpora: screened before labelling (41 §6); see the ANSWER strata manifest

one_shot.rule: a second scoring pass by the same arm on this partition is FAIL_ONE_SHOT; a forced re-score is a recorded replacement with both run ids kept (06)

role: confirmatory: scored once per arm, on a checkpoint chosen in advance (06, one-shot discipline)
statement: Study 002's confirmatory population: the When2Call confirmatory side unchanged, plus the ANSWER strata. The ANSWER gold is a provisional model reference (two non-Claude models agreeing), not human gold. ANSWER-natural (n = 284) resolves margins of 11.6 points or more. ANSWER-constructed (n = 771) resolves margins of 7.1 points or more.
